description:
The blog data set, version 1.4.2, currently holds two articles. The first entry originates from the file **content/2023/09/awesome-tech-trends.md**; its base name is *awesome-tech-trends*, and both the stripped base and stripped‑language base are also *awesome-tech-trends*. It was published on **October 1 2023** (Unix time 1696185600). The title appears as `

Top Tech Trends to Watch in 2024

` (plain text: “Top Tech Trends to Watch in 2024”). An introductory aside reads `

Stay ahead of the curve with these emerging technologies.

` (text: “Stay ahead of the curve with these emerging technologies.”). The author is identified by `Jane Doe` (text: “Jane Doe”). The main article content is `

Artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and edge AI are set to reshape industries. This article explores their potential impact and practical applications.

` (text: “Artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and edge AI are set to reshape industries. This article explores their potential impact and practical applications.”). It is tagged with **technology**, **trends**, and **2024**. The second article is stored in **content/2023/07/healthy-eating-habits.md**, with a base name of *healthy-eating-habits* and identical stripped base values (*healthy-eating-habits*). Its publication date is **June 30 2023** (Unix time 1688160000). The title markup is `

10 Healthy Eating Habits for a Better Life

` (text: “10 Healthy Eating Habits for a Better Life”). The aside reads `

Simple changes that make a big difference.

` (text: “Simple changes that make a big difference.”). Authored by `John Smith` (text: “John Smith”), the article body is `

From mindful portion sizes to incorporating more plant-based meals, discover practical tips to improve your diet and overall wellbeing.

` (text: “From mindful portion sizes to incorporating more plant-based meals, discover practical tips to improve your diet and overall wellbeing.”). This piece carries the tags **health**, **nutrition**, and **lifestyle**.
